rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that happened or existed before the reference point.

example.english: The previous film was really good.
example.jyutping: zi1 cin4 ge3 din6 jing2 hou2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for the previous item, version, term of office, or other member in an ordered series, such as 上一任總理.

example.english: The previous prime minister did quite well.
example.jyutping: soeng6 jat1 jam6 zung2 lei5 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the previous occasion or event, such as the previous meeting or visit.

example.english: The previous meeting lasted three hours.
example.traditional: 上次嘅會議開咗三個鐘。
example.jyutping: soeng6 ci3 ge3 wui6 ji5 hoi1 zo2 saam1 go3 zung1
